customManagers.description: Bump the cargo tools and zizmor that taiki-e/install-action installs, pinned as `tool: <crate>@<version>` in the workflows.

packageRules.description: serde_json is pinned exactly in normal and dev dependencies, and Cargo allows one 1.x in the build. Keep every pin in the weekly batch, so the dev-dependency patch group never bumps half of them (#129, #130).

The inbox's types for preact, htm, marked and mermaid are the vendored releases (crates/cli/src/commands/serve/web/static/vendor/README.md), and move with those files by hand: a test fails when package.json and the README differ.
